name: Zahin Ahad
headline: I find the bugs before your users do.
subheadline: Six years of breaking software on purpose. I do test automation, API and performance testing, and release audits for web and mobile teams.
location: Bangladesh · Working remotely with teams worldwide
about: I make sure the software a team ships works, holds up under pressure and is pleasant to use. I've spent close to six years in QA, from manual exploratory testing to leading automation for international clients, and I've learned that quality is a habit a team builds, not a phase at the end of a project.

I like digging into the details: the edge case nobody thought of, the flaky test everyone ignores, the slow API call that only shows up under load. I pair that with a practical approach. You get tests that run in CI, reports your team can act on, and a QA process that keeps working after I'm gone.
